en.note: Internship project, Oct–Nov 2023. The source tables are anonymized exports (brands AA–EE, masked listing IDs) covering October 2023; every number on this page is computed from them at build time.

stats.label: Source rows
stats.hint: 5 tables: ads, orders, inventory, listing page, daily totals

fig1.title: The product-selection metric system
fig1.sub: 5 dimensions · 9 groups · 31 metrics — what to check before a category or product gets shelf space
fig1.caption: Exhibit 1. Demand and competition decide whether a category is worth entering; product, ratings and price decide which listing wins inside it. The tree was the checklist behind the brief's columns.

fig2.title: What the daily brief is made of
fig2.caption: Exhibit 2. Five exports joined on date, marketplace and listing. The brief reads top-down: the 7-day trend says whether something changed, the brand split says where, and the per-listing table says which link and why — stock, ads or price.

nodes.name: 7-day trend
nodes.num: units · revenue · change · views · refund rate

nodes.name: Per-listing health
nodes.num: 7-day avg · days to sell-out · CTR · ACoS · rank

fig3.title: October, day by day: units sold and listings out of stock
fig3.sub: bars = units sold across all brands and marketplaces · dots = selling listings with zero inventory that day, of 82
fig3.caption: Exhibit 3. Units peaked at 1,533 on Oct 2 and held near 950 a day through Oct 21, then fell to about 160 a day. Over the same month the number of selling listings with no stock climbed from 4 to 21. The brief's days-to-sell-out column exists to catch this a week earlier.

fig4.title: The best-selling listing: price, category rank and units
fig4.sub: one listing (brand CC, US) · 2,951 units in October, 15% of all units sold · rank axis is inverted, higher = better
fig4.caption: Exhibit 4. The price was raised five times, from 29.99 to 38.59. Rank improved to #74 on Oct 17, then slid to #878 by Oct 31 as daily units fell from over 100 to single digits. One month of exports cannot separate price from stock and season, but a brief that shows the three side by side raises the question the same day.

fig5.title: Ad efficiency per listing: spend against ACoS
fig5.sub: 66 advertised listings · x = ad spend in October, log scale · y = ACoS = ad spend ÷ ad sales · hollow = spend with no ad sales
fig5.caption: Exhibit 5. Two CC listings took 40% of the spend and returned 48% of ad sales at 14–16% ACoS. Five small listings spent more on ads than they sold through them, and eight spent with no ad sales at all — together under 450 — which is what the brief flags first.

fig3.title: 10 月每日销量与缺货链接数
fig3.sub: 柱形表示全部品牌和站点的日销量；圆点表示 82 条有销售记录的商品链接中，当日库存为零的数量
fig3.caption: 图 3：10 月 2 日日销量达到峰值 1,533 件，此后至 10 月 21 日维持在约 950 件，随后降至约 160 件。整月内，有销售记录但库存为零的商品链接数从 4 条增加到 21 条。日报中的「预计可售天数」用于提前识别一周内可能售罄的链接。

fig4.title: 畅销商品链接：售价、类目排名与日销量
fig4.sub: 品牌 CC，美国站 · 10 月售出 2,951 件，占总销量的 15% · 排名轴反向排列，位置越高表示排名越靠前
fig4.caption: 图 4：该链接在 10 月提价五次，售价从 29.99 调至 38.59。类目排名在 10 月 17 日达到第 74 名，月底降至第 878 名，日销量从一百多件降至个位数。单月数据无法区分价格、库存和季节性因素各自的影响，但并列展示这三项指标，有助于团队及时发现并排查问题。

fig5.title: 商品链接广告效率：花费与广告销售成本比
fig5.sub: 66 条投放广告的商品链接 · 横轴为 10 月广告花费，采用对数刻度；纵轴为广告销售成本比（ACoS），即广告花费 ÷ 广告销售额；空心点表示有花费但无广告销售额
fig5.caption: 图 5：CC 品牌的两条链接占总广告花费的 40%，贡献 48% 的广告销售额，ACoS 为 14%—16%。另有 5 条投放规模较小的链接，广告花费超过广告销售额；还有 8 条产生花费却未产生广告销售额。这 13 条链接的花费合计不足 450，是日报优先标记的异常。
